name: EduVenture — Education and EdTech Institution Management
description: A higher education management simulation where participants lead a mid-sized university through enrollment decline, digital disruption, and funding pressure. Learners balance academic excellence with financial viability, manage program portfolios across undergraduate, graduate, and executive education, and navigate the digital transformation of education delivery over three academic years.
